key.name: border-enabled
key.description: Whether configurable borders should be applied to windows.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Width of the window border in logical pixels.

key.name: dark-active-border-color
key.description: Border color for the focused window in dark mode.

key.name: dark-inactive-border-color
key.description: Border color for unfocused windows in dark mode.

key.name: light-active-border-color
key.description: Border color for the focused window in light mode.

key.name: light-inactive-border-color
key.description: Border color for unfocused windows in light mode.

key.name: rounded-corners-enabled
key.description: Whether configurable rounded corners should be applied to windows.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Radius of rounded window corners in logical pixels.

key.name: round-maximized-windows
key.description: Whether maximized windows should keep rounded corners.

key.name: shadows-enabled
key.description: Whether configurable window shadows should be applied.

key.name: active-shadow-strength
key.description: Opacity multiplier for the focused window shadow.

key.name: inactive-shadow-strength
key.description: Opacity multiplier for unfocused window shadows.
